title: Real attack replay: Jammertest 2024 u-blox logs through the GNSS interference monitor, with RTKLIB SPP
summary: Replays 7 public u-blox logs from Jammertest 2024 (University of Vaasa VAARA dataset, about 13 h, 21 labelled test slots: drive-by and convoy jamming, motorcade spoofing, time-offset and pseudorange-ramp spoofing at Bleik, jamming-then-spoofing) through the unmodified gnss-interference-monitor scorer. A stdlib adapter frames mixed UBX + NMEA (the logs have no UBX NAV messages and break pyubx2), builds epochs from GGA/RMC/GSV with L1-band C/N0 only, and reconstructs a monotonic time axis so receiver time jumps reach clock_jump. Labels come from the VAARA field log plus two tests recovered from the 2024 NPRA plan shifted by the observed 50 min offset. Reports per test detected / time to detect / detector, alarm time in quiet and unlogged spans, for the shipped scorer and four variants, and RTKLIB SPP error (Docker) with logged vs IGS broadcast ephemerides. Findings with the scorer at git dae8229 (the first three were fixed in the scorer afterwards and the replay re-run): the constant-velocity pos_drift latches on a driving car; a cn0_rise sub-alert freezes the C/N0 baseline for good and hides later drops; staircase power evades cn0_drop; spoofing mostly appeared as a C/N0 drop while the receiver kept its true fix; spoofer ephemerides poison post-processing with the logged nav file.
verified: Ran 2026-11-06. replay.py (Python 3.14.7, stdlib) on 7 VAARA u-blox logs downloaded by fetch_data.sh (64 MB .xz): 21 labelled slots (20 attack, 1 quiet), shipped scorer and variants B/C/D/F; result JSON in results/. RTKLIB demo5 v2.5.1 SPP in the rtklib-demo5 Docker image (built from samples/gnss-rinex-processing/docker, 91 s) on 3 logs with logged nav and with IGS BRDC from the BKG mirror; spp_eval.py numbers in results/. 13 tests on a synthetic VAARA-shaped stream: OK (1 skipped) on /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 3.14.7 without packages, OK with pyubx2 1.4.1 on Python 3.13.15; 4 single mutations each fail 1-3 tests. Not verified: test windows beyond the VAARA field log (2.4.2/2.4.3 are plan-shifted guesses), receiver truth beyond self-referenced medians, phone logs, MON-SPAN, OSNMA on the logged Galileo data. Re-run on 2026-11-06 with the reworked scorer (after dae8229); the before-results are kept in results/before_dae8229/ and the README table shows both.
first_command: python3 -m unittest -v test_real_attack_replay.py && ./fetch_data.sh && python3 replay.py --data data/vaara --no-pos-drift --baseline-max-score 0.3
group: GNSS threats: detect, map, locate, authenticate
shows: The interference monitor on real Jammertest 2024 jamming and spoofing: per-test detection, time to detect, false alarms, and RTKLIB SPP error
runtime: tests 0.5 s; download 64 MB (~25 s here); replay of all 7 logs ~14 s; RTKLIB image build ~1.5 min, SPP 2-4 s per log
key_result: [Per-test table](README.md#results), current scorer: 20 of 20 attack slots alert (2.4.3 staircase at +8 s), 0 alerts in the one logged quiet window, 1-6 alarm raises per hour of unlogged time (possibly real tests); the scorer at dae8229 alarmed 86 % of driving time. Alerts up to 300 s before a slot count. 2.4.2 jumped receiver UTC +900 s (clock_jump). u-blox fix stayed within 3.2 m in 2.6.x spoofing while RTKLIB SPP jumped up to 4455 km
